## How to use this workbook

Each chapter follows the same structure: learning objectives, why the
topic matters, a mental model, a visual overview, the technical core
(equations with every symbol defined), a fully worked numeric example,
a comparison table, comprehension questions, a common misconception, an
applied exercise, an interview-style question, a chapter recap, and
sources. Short questions appear near the concept they test, with space
left for written answers if you're using this as a workbook rather than
only a reading; full solutions are collected in the answer key
(@sec-solutions-ch1, @sec-solutions-ch2, @sec-solutions-ch3,
@sec-solutions-ch4) rather than revealed inline, so you can attempt
each question before checking it. A notation quick reference
(@sec-notation) covers every symbol Chapters 1-4 use.
